1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __having a molecular weight__ of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with __at least one__ multivalent cation crosslinker.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and __other__ anionic surfactants.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising __at least one__ monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __nanoparticle has an average particle size of from about 100 to 900 nm in diameter__.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __with a molecular weight of less than 2000 Da__ and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping __at least one multivalent cation__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al. 

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __that can be crosslinked with the composition of claim 1__; and c) a fluid.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, __or N,N-dimethylacrylamide__.

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid __comprises brine or seawater__.
